headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with 1.5+ years of experience delivering digital and print creatives, visual identity systems, and AI-assisted workflows.

skills.label: Design Tools & Core
skills.items: Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, CorelDRAW, typography, layout design, visual hierarchy, print production

skills.label: Workflow & Systems
skills.items: AI-assisted design workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly), design templates, visual systems, print-ready file management

skills.label: UX & Prototyping
skills.items: Wireframing, prototyping, user flows, usability testing, responsive design

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Designed 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Produced marketing collateral including banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, and presentations.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders to deliver assets with low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, colour accuracy, typography, layout, and visual hierarchy.
Leveraged AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and creative exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Conducted usability testing and fed findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Created wireframes and prototypes for early-stage digital products.
Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Developed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator to build product visuals and marketing assets.

projects.name: Branding kit for AT Creation startup
bullets: Designed complete branding kit including logo, typography, and palette for an early-stage startup.

projects.name: Social campaign for a fashion brand
bullets: Delivered an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her commercial graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions, highlighting 100+ digital and print creatives, visual systems, and AI-assisted workflows to match Nestasia's focus on digital platforms and AI tool usage.
omitted: Bounceless B2B UX case study (omitted because this role focuses on graphic design and visual creation rather than UX case studies)

Extra portfolio project titles without documentation (Zest Club, Potted Paradise, Design × Engineering, Learnara, Common Ground, Foodbank, Domino's rethought) to keep the resume concise and focused on verified outcomes.
